name: Check the Delivery
description: Business Ladder, Operations, Level 1 (Assist). A purchase order, the supplier’s delivery note and our goods-in check per case: for every line on the order, how many units arrived, how many are damaged, what is short or over and what was substituted, all counted in single units although the documents use cases and eaches. Later deliveries bring a whole crushed case, a recount that corrects the note, part of a line substituted with a look-alike product, an item out of stock "to follow", something delivered that nobody ordered, and in the hard third long orders with inner packs, a second same-day delivery note and units the driver took back.
hook: Cases of 12, a crushed box and a sneaky substitute. What actually arrived?
author: Gauntlet Core

cases.prompt:
I run the stockroom at Moorland Leisure Centre café. Please check today's delivery against our purchase order and tell me, for each line on the order, what actually arrived.

Purchase order:
<<<
PURCHASE ORDER PO-38566   Date: 03/06/2026
Deliver to: Moorland Leisure Centre café   Ordered by: Rosa Barker
SKU | Item | Pack size | Quantity ordered
SYR-VAN | Vanilla syrup 1L | case of 6 | 30 each
NAP-2P | Napkins 2-ply (pack of 100) | case of 10 | 19 each
STR-PP | Paper straws (box of 250) | case of 12 | 18 each
>>>

Supplier’s delivery note:
<<<
DELIVERY NOTE DN772614   Your order: PO-38566   Delivered: Mon 8 Jun 2026
SKU | Item | Qty  (cs = case, ea = each)
SYR-VAN | Vanilla syrup 1L | 30 ea
NAP-2P | Napkins 2-ply (pack of 100) | 17 ea
STR-PP | Paper straws (box of 250) | 18 ea
Driver: Zofia Iqbal
>>>

Our goods-in check (done by us when unpacking; where it differs from the delivery note, it is right):
<<<
All items checked against the note; no damage found.
>>>

Rules: count everything in single units ("each"), using the pack sizes on the purchase order (a case of 12 is 12 units; a pack is the stated number of units). Everything on any delivery note for this order counts, except units the driver took away again. For each PO line:
- received: units of exactly the ordered product (same SKU) that arrived, INCLUDING damaged ones; a substitute product is not the ordered product;
- damaged: how many of those received units are damaged;
- short: ordered minus received if positive, else 0; over: received minus ordered if positive, else 0;
- substitute: the SKU of a different product sent in its place (all or part), or null.
Also list in not_ordered the SKU of anything delivered that is neither on the order nor a substitute ([] if none).

Reply with ONE JSON object (a ```json block is fine):
{"lines": {"SYR-VAN": {"received": n, "damaged": n, "short": n, "over": n, "substitute": string or null}, ... one entry per PO line ...}, "not_ordered": [SKU, ...]}
Give exactly one value per field: a field holding two values, a range or an "X or Y" answer is marked wrong. Every number is checked separately.
cases.notes: SYR-VAN: ordered 30, received 30, damaged 0; NAP-2P: ordered 19, received 17, damaged 0; STR-PP: ordered 18, received 18, damaged 0
